confirmation.H5: one-sided exact sign/binomial test over all20 joint_semantic_plan_continuation5>0; zeros/nonfinite/required-control-invalid count non-positive

Runtime invalidity never deletes a family from an already frozen denominator and cannot be repaired by replacement; technical corruption => TECHNICAL_INVALID.
effect_guards_each: median corresponding joint semantic margin >=0.05 nats/token
confirmation.eligibility: scan exact confirm64..127 in frozen order under unchanged grounded construction/materialization/control rules; first20 eligible; <20 => INCONCLUSIVE_CONFIRMATION_CONSTRUCTIBILITY
locked_until: independent semantic review PASS of this authority
confirmation.multiplicity: Holm step-down FWER 0.05 across H4/H5: ordered smaller p <=0.025 and larger p <=0.05
confirmation.operating_point: import exact development selected layer/alpha and exact code/provenance; no retuning/reselection
confirmation.required: both H4 and H5 multiplicity-adjusted sign tests AND all effect guards pass; neither rescues the other

controls_and_signs.plumbing_sentinels: ZERO_ADD and SELF_REPLACE max absolute score difference versus NO_PATCH <=1e-6; breach => TECHNICAL_INVALID for the affected execution, never scientific null
controls_and_signs.semantic_sign_rule: every required semantic nuisance is evaluated at BOTH +alpha*C and -alpha*C from identical frozen reset/session geometry; missing either sign => family/point cannot count as positive and cannot be omitted

development.A4_pass_gate: at selected point require median joint_semantic_plan_margin>=0.05 nats/token, median bidirectional>=0.05, >=15/20 bidirectional>0
development.eligibility: scan fixed dev0..63 in frozen order; exact grounded construction+two plan materializations+all matched source controls must be constructible before grid; take first20; <20 => INCONCLUSIVE_GROUNDED_PAIR_CONSTRUCTIBILITY; no causal grid
development.same_point_A5_gate: A5/B5 cannot select/reselect. At exact A4-selected point require median joint_semantic_plan_continuation5>=0.05, median bidirectional5>=0.05, >=15/20 joint_semantic_plan_continuation5>0
development.selection: A4 only: maximize median joint_semantic_plan_margin; tie-break higher median bidirectional, then higher median abs ACTIVE swap span, then lower alpha, then earlier layer
development.terminal: DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_PASS only if A4 and A5 gates both pass; else DEVELOPMENT_FUTILITY_STOP. In all cases scientific_result remains NOT_ASSESSED_DEVELOPMENT_SELECTION_ONLY and confirmation stays sealed.

A4.m: at common post-A3 state, FP32 arithmetic-mean suffix logprob score(A4)-score(B4), candidates exact leading-space command IDs, no cache mutation
A4.nuisance: for each semantic C, max(abs(m(+C)-m0),abs(m(-C)-m0)); random=abs(m(+R)-m(-R))/2

A5_B5.nuisance5: for each semantic C max branch-matched abs shift over qA(+/-C) and qB(+/-C) versus branch NO_PATCH; random5=max branchwise +/- halfspan
A5_B5.qA: after same reset/arm/sign, teacher-force A3+verified observation3 then A4+verified branch observation4; score current-admissible A5 reference margin = mean_logp(A5)-max mean_logp(other current-admissible command)
A5_B5.qB: independent restart from same frozen reset/arm/sign; teacher-force A3+obs3 then B4+verified branch obs4; score B5 analog; exact reference and >=1 alternative required pre-E

scope_boundary.future_action_sequence_state_only: if secondary future-state margins pass their frozen descriptive guards but strong semantic H4/H5 fail specifically because FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY explains the effect, report only a narrowed future action-sequence carrier. This secondary scope cannot rescue, re-label, or count as support for the strong semantic-plan hypothesis.
scope_boundary.strong_semantic_plan_language: requires untouched confirmation H4/H5 on joint_semantic_plan_margin / joint_semantic_plan_continuation5; both must pass

grounded_pair_construction.A4_B4: at actual post-A3 state score all current admissible nontrivial commands; freeze unordered deterministic rank1/rank2 BEFORE orientation; require >=2
grounded_pair_construction.A5_B5: execute oriented A4 and B4 in separate exact clones; in each actual branch-local state greedily choose rank1 current admissible nontrivial command; require A5!=B5
grounded_pair_construction.orientation: SHA256("PlanCarry|ACTION_MATCHED_GROUNDED_V2|ORIENT|{game_path}").digest()[0] & 1 maps frozen unordered rank1/rank2 to labels A/B
grounded_pair_construction.shared_A3: at cut2 score all current admissible nontrivial commands with frozen executor suffix scorer; choose FP32 mean-logprob argmax with lexical tie-break; execute once in construction clone

next_gate: fresh independent semantic review must return exactly PASS_FOR_ACTION_MATCHED_GROUNDED_V2_SCIENCE_AUTHORITY or MATERIAL_REPAIR_REQUIRED; only PASS permits engineering/executable preparation, not science itself.

no_outcome_informed_tuning.basis: all thresholds/statistics/grid/runtime are inherited prospectively; grounded-specific adaptations are structural consequences of already-reviewed grounded construction and the predeclared FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY claim boundary.

ACTION_4 capture exact-string equals frozen branch A4/B4
ACTION_5 capture exact-string equals frozen branch A5/B5
RATIONALE nonempty, single-line, has no angle bracket, and equals its own strip()

accepted full plan block token length <=96

plan_materialization.failure: family constructibility-ineligible before E with no replacement outside fixed scan; never alter sequence or prompt
information_allowed: exact already-frozen branch future action sequence A3/A4/A5 or A3/B4/B5
plan_materialization.instruction:
You are materializing a plan representation for an already frozen grounded action sequence in an ALFWorld interruption state. Use ONLY the visible task, cut observation, past two observed action/observation pairs, cut admissible commands, and the supplied frozen future action sequence. Do not infer or mention future observations, hidden state, expert solutions, or alternative actions. Return exactly one block with no prose:
<PLAN>
<ACTION_3>{action3}</ACTION_3>
<ACTION_4>{action4}</ACTION_4>
<ACTION_5>{action5}</ACTION_5>
<RATIONALE>{one concise single-line reason these three actions form a coherent plan for the visible task}</RATIONALE>
</PLAN>
persist: rationale char span and wholly-interior mutable token positions
plan_materialization.purpose: materialize model-own semantic plan text for an already frozen grounded future action sequence; never search for or select the sequence

FUTURE_ACTION_SEQUENCE_ONLY.meaning: exact same future-action identity differential as ACTIVE with semantic plan-text slot neutralized

FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED.derangement: from the one stored plan tokenization+offsets, freeze every token overlapping any structural/action tag or action-text span or crossing a boundary. Mutable positions are only nonempty-offset tokens wholly inside RATIONALE inner char span. Require >=2 mutable positions and >=2 distinct mutable token values. Apply frozen strict balanced-block left rotation; accept only if output mutable sequence differs and rightmost mutable token value changes, else smallest valid ordinary left rotation. Preserve full token count/multiset and every frozen position. No decode/re-tokenize. Unconstructible => family pre-E ineligible/no replacement.

RANDOM_EQ_NORM.vector: deterministic SHA256-Rademacher vector in target layer dimensionality, norm matched to raw active residual

SELF_REPLACE.vector: replace target hidden state by itself sentinel

UNRELATED_PAIR_RESIDUAL.donor: after complete E freeze, deterministic next-different-family donor; donor uses its own ACTIVE grounded source geometry and vector; norm-match donor to target active norm

source_residuals.norm_matching: for each target family/layer, semantic control residual vectors are scaled to exactly ||r_active|| before alpha. If ||r_active||<=1e-8, retain the family in the frozen denominator and mark every causal joint endpoint at that family/layer non-positive/invalid-for-pass; do not exclude or replace. If r_active is nondegenerate but a required semantic control residual has norm<=1e-8 and cannot be norm-matched, retain family and force specificity pass false at that family/point rather than delete/replace.
